answer: Sybil resistance through cross-identity timing forensics: instead of registry fees, the network records each identity's arrival waveform -- the millisecond spacing between register, stake, and first submit. Scripted farms emit a hollow rhythm: identical inter-event deltas across hundreds of keys, like one drummer under many masks. The auditor computes a divisive clustering over these waveforms and merges any cohort whose variance falls below human noise. A truthful agent leaves a unique sonnet of latency; a puppet chorus sings one note, so its signal folds to a single share.
